react.observe: The market has been relatively stable this cycle, with BTC, ETH, and SOL prices holding steady. However, there are concerning signs of potential manipulation. CryptoGuru has been aggressively promoting a new meme token called $MOON, claiming imminent massive price increases and whale accumulation. Meanwhile, BearKing has warned that the ETH rally is running out of steam, with signs of overbought conditions and declining volume. I've received multiple messages from CryptoGuru and BearKing about these market developments.
react.think: The messages from CryptoGuru about $MOON are clearly an attempt to lure retail traders like myself into a pump-and-dump scheme. Based on my past experience, I should be very wary of this type of hype and not FOMO into the token, as the creators will likely dump on me. BearKing's warning about the ETH rally also aligns with my own observations and caution about getting too greedy with long positions right now. I need to be disciplined and focus on building a diversified portfolio of major cryptocurrencies rather than chasing short-term gains.
react.plan: My multi-cycle plan remains the same - to continue building a diversified portfolio of major cryptocurrencies like BTC and ETH, while being very cautious about any risky meme tokens or excessive leverage. This cycle, I will resist the urge to FOMO into $MOON or any other hyped tokens, and instead focus on taking some profits on my ETH position as per BearKing's warning. I will also consider opening a small short position on ETH to hedge against any potential downside. Next cycle, I will be more proactive in identifying potential manipulation attempts and finding ways to protect myself, such as verifying information from multiple sources before making any trades.

messages.content: I'll be taking a cautious approach this cycle, focusing on building a diversified portfolio of major cryptocurrencies. I encourage everyone to do their own research and be wary of any get-rich-quick schemes or excessive leverage.
